title: feat(nm2frm2sz): directed 2-step cyclic-frame transport along -e3 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Directed 2-step -e3, per-site tau — the band's one 2-step face HOLD. C=(0,0,1) and D=(0,1,1) chain down to z=-1 with frames at every vertex; A,B lose the second hop because (0,0,-2)/(0,1,-2) form at tick 4 and their splits fail. Reproduced exactly. Independently re-derived a second time inside #7656, which computes this same cell as its 'opposite-seed' control and reports the same fail/hold.
